notes.text: PROBATIO is the owner's ruling of 2026-11-10: the danger the witnesses give him, turned under command into an office. It is not in the sources

goetia.textus: (63.) Andras. —The Sixty-third Spirit is Andras. He is a Great Marquis, appearing in the Form of an Angel with a Head like a Black Night Raven, riding upon a strong Black Wolf, and having a Sharp and Bright Sword flourished aloft in his hand. His Office is to sow Discords. If the Exorcist have not a care, he will slay both him and his fellows. He governeth 30 Legions of Spirits, and this is his Seal, etc.
